verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships its own programmatic interfaces. `edge0 serve` exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions HTTP endpoint (shown with a curl example), and a Python API (AutoEngine.from_pretrained) can drive the engine directly. The documentation is limited to README snippets, and the docs-md probe returned 404, so the API's breadth and depth are unproven. missing for 10: a dedicated API reference (endpoints, parameters, auth, error handling), documented coverage beyond chat completions (e.g. model/adapter management via API), independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
